title: Enterprise Support: Handling conditions for paid rate-error credit
content:
Enterprise Support — Handling conditions for paid rate-error credit.

## Handling condition

For paid rate-error credit: Before posting a paid support rate-error correction, the exact source invoice must have its completed arithmetic review with approved status and incorrect decision.

For paid rate-error credit: This paid rate-error reconciliation applies to full-month, on-demand standard US East source service with approved negotiated support terms and reviewed US untaxed tax treatment. Support service records retain the already official compute export physical quantities for the exact source support invoice; they carry no financial posting. Other products confer no support discount. The independently reconstructed subtotal must equal the official review pretax net amount; the source is US untaxed, so amount and pretax net amount are equal and signed tax amount is zero.
